text:
anya: quick decision needed: final GA scope for Hosted API. options: ship broad (autoscale + advanced batching) or ship narrow (basic autoscale, strong SLAs/docs) and iterate.

mike: narrow. batching still causes OOMs on older GPUs. not worth GA risk.

carla: docs can cover narrow scope well. we need SLA language + runbook examples. I can own docs if we keep APIs stable.

ben: finance requirement: publish default pricing tiers marked as "pilot pricing" and require an automated alert if unit cost > baseline by 20% for >72h. also want a default billing floor for Dedicated pilots.

anya: proposed minimum GA checklist:
- SLA: 99.9% availability for committed plans (measured monthly)
- Observability: per-route traces + token-cost view in Console
- Support: escalation path + oncall rotation in playbook
- Docs: onboarding + troubleshooting + autoscale config examples
- Pricing: visible tiers (pilot) + cost-spike alert rule

mike: will add monitoring rule & playbook snippet.

carla: will open docs PR with SLA blurb and examples by EOD.

ben: will draft pilot pricing copy and billing floor proposal for legal/finance review.

ops-bot: Reminder: Add GA oncall rotation to playbook. Link: https://confluence.example/ga-oncall-playbook

anya: decision: ship MVP GA = Hosted API + basic autoscale + observability + docs. advanced batching and experimental autoscale deferred post-GA. reconvene tomorrow 10:00 PT to sign off.
